-- wafer map measurement: ring fails, dies, clusters of size >= 5, largest cluster
var nr, nc.
read nr, nc.
var g[nr, nc], seen[nr, nc], st[nr * nc].
var r, c, dx, dy, px, py, dmax, d2, ring, dies, clusters, big, top, cur, cr, cc, sz.

for r from 0 below nr do
  for c from 0 below nc do
    read g[r, c].
  done
done

-- pass 1: number of dies and the largest d2 over all dies
dmax <- 0.
for r from 0 below nr do
  for c from 0 below nc do
    if g[r, c] > 0 then
      dies <- dies + 1.
      dx <- 2 * r - (nr - 1).
      dy <- 2 * c - (nc - 1).
      d2 <- dx * dx + dy * dy.
      dmax <- max(dmax, d2).
    done
  done
done

-- pass 2: failing dies in the ring 50%..100% (2500 * D2 <= 10000 * d2)
ring <- 0.
for r from 0 below nr do
  for c from 0 below nc do
    if g[r, c] = 2 then
      dx <- 2 * r - (nr - 1).
      dy <- 2 * c - (nc - 1).
      d2 <- dx * dx + dy * dy.
      if 2500 * dmax <= 10000 * d2 then
        ring <- ring + 1.
      done
    done
  done
done

-- pass 3: 8-connected clusters of failing dies, iterative flood fill
clusters <- 0.
big <- 0.
for r from 0 below nr do
  for c from 0 below nc do
    if g[r, c] = 2 and seen[r, c] = 0 then
      seen[r, c] <- 1.
      top <- 0.
      st[top] <- r * nc + c.
      top <- top + 1.
      sz <- 0.
      while top > 0 do
        top <- top - 1.
        cur <- st[top].
        cr <- cur div nc.
        cc <- cur mod nc.
        sz <- sz + 1.
        for dx from -1 through 1 do
          for dy from -1 through 1 do
            px <- cr + dx.
            py <- cc + dy.
            if px >= 0 and px < nr and py >= 0 and py < nc then
              if g[px, py] = 2 and seen[px, py] = 0 then
                seen[px, py] <- 1.
                st[top] <- px * nc + py.
                top <- top + 1.
              done
            done
          done
        done
      done
      if sz >= 5 then
        clusters <- clusters + 1.
      done
      big <- max(big, sz).
    done
  done
done

say ring, dies, clusters, big.
